{{Quote|So he sent me to Hapes aboard the Pursuit light cruiser ''Shepherd'', carrying two squadrons of TIE fighters and accompanied by eight gunships. My men thought we were on a recon patrol and that our purpose was to keep the Hapans honest. But I knew better&mdash;I knew we were going to a place from which we'd never return.|Osvald Teshik recalls the events prior to the Battle of Andalia|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The '''''Shepherd''''' was a [[Pursuit-class light cruiser|''Pursuit''-class light cruiser]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] as of [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], it traveled to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] under the command of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]], accompanied by eight [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] force then proceeded to the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]], where it was ordered to [[Battle of Andalia|engage]] the [[Hapan]] forces due to Teshik's failure to apprehend [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]]-affiliated [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]] who had previously [[Capture of Coh Veshiv|captured]] Imperial [[Advisor/Legends|Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]]. However, the larger and more heavily-armed Hapan opposition soundly defeated the Imperial attack force, with the ''Shepherd'' being obliterated after its forward [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were taken down and its main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] destroyed.

==Description==
A [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]&ndash;manufactured [[Pursuit-class light cruiser|''Pursuit''-class light cruiser]], the ''Shepherd'' was 500 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] long and equipped with both [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] and a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], as well as a main [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]]. The [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] tower could accommodate multiple [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] and had [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suits]] stored near it, though the [[Light cruiser]] itself was equipped with [[Life support/Legends|life support]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]] of its last mission, the ''Shepherd'' carried two [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==History==
{{Quote|We were the last survivors&hellip;by then our shields were failing.|Osvald Teshik recalls the Battle of Andalia|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
The ''Shepherd'' was part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Rebels kidnapped [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Coh Veshiv]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]], in the [[Oversector/Legends|oversector]] commanded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Osvald Teshik]]. Angered at Teshik's failure, [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent him to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] aboard the ''Shepherd'', carrying two squadrons of [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighters]] and accompanied by eight [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]], supposedly as a recon patrol. Teshik's force was then commanded to [[Battle of Andalia|engage]] the [[Hapan]] forces at the [[Andalia system/Legends|Andalia system]], but before Teshik and the crew even met the Hapan [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the Grand Admiral knew that the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] was sending him and his crew to [[Death/Legends|die]].<ref name="Warfare" />

The ''Shepherd'' faced heavy opposition&mdash;five [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s and eight [[Nova-class battle cruiser|''Nova''-class battle cruisers]]&mdash;which had been tipped off about the Imperials' arrival. Although the ''Shepherd''{{'s}} crew thought they would flee, Teshik had the TIEs launch to attack the opposition, as he knew this confrontation was the Emperor's reprisal. The ''Shepherd'' was the last surviving Imperial [[Starship/Legends|craft]], with all the gunships and TIE fighters destroyed. Once the ''Shepherd''{{'s}} forward deflector shields failed, the lead Battle Dragon launched a salvo of torpedoes that hit the ''Shepherd''{{'s}} main reactor, causing the ''Pursuit''-class [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to blow apart. The explosion took with it all hands but Teshik, who was pulled out of the ''Shepherd'' by a [[Hull/Legends|hull]] breach while wearing an enviro-suit, before being picked up by a [[snoopship]] sent by Palpatine to ensure that the Emperor's wrath was recorded. Teshik later recounted the tale of the ''Shepherd'' to his Rebel captors in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="Warfare" />

==Commanders and crew==
{{Quote|Some of my officers were still barking orders&mdash;dead men clacking their jaws in a dumb show of honor. Others were begging me for new instructions. A few were sitting catatonic at their posts while alarms flashed around them.|Osvald Teshik recalls the Battle of Andalia|<ref name="Warfare" />}}
Grand Admiral Osvald Teshik helmed the ''Shepherd'' during its ill-fated trip to the Hapes Cluster, with multiple [[Officer/Legends|officers]] crewing the bridge tower, including a [[Unidentified Imperial deck officer (Shepherd)|deck officer]]. When the bridge tower crew realized they would die, they showed reactions ranging from begging Teshik for new orders to sitting catatonic at their stations. The entire crew, save Teshik, was killed when the ''Shepherd'' was destroyed.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Shepherd'' was mentioned in the introduction of [[2012]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|reference text]] dedicated to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] many conflicts, written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]].<ref name="Warfare" />
